hue.specific_finding: The summary says the US/ARVN player must recapture Hue within an allotted number of turns. Rob Gibson’s contemporary1978 reference for the original SDC game explicitly says there is no time limit: play continues until all NVA/VC units are removed from the walled city. Victory is calculated from destroyed-unit points and additional points for each turn the NVA/VC retain an InnerCity foothold. An invented fixed deadline changes the ending and victory incentives. Specific MAJOR applies to the originalSDC scope expressly included by the summary; exact1982 revisions and full numeric VP/tie rules remain uncertified. No full audit or body repair.

hyper-battle.specific_finding: The summary gives initiative, a movement phase and then a separate combat phase. The matching 1981 W.G.Armintrout reference instead describes a player’s move-and-fight phase: ships move one at a time and conduct attacks during movement. This is followed by damage-control rolls to return face-down ships to action, then the opponent’s turn. Defenders also fire when an attacker enters their hex. Moving every ship before attacking and omitting the repair step changes tactical timing and which ships return to play. Specific MAJOR against the scoped contemporary reference; exact initiative/repair thresholds/full CRTs remain missing. No full audit or body repair.
